instruction: I want to enable minimal view mode in VLC for a distraction-free viewing experience. How can I configure VLC to start in minimal view mode?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling minimal view mode in VLC (qt-minimal-view=1). Uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric to verify the setting in vlcrc config file. Default is 0 (disabled), task sets it to 1 (enabled).
